buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Terms And Conditions 1. Manufacturing Capability: The Bidder Should be a strictly Original Equipment Manufacturer ofrequired ite ms (OEM) or Authorized Dealer of OEM. Documentary proof to be submitted: val id OEM authorization certificate on OEM’s letter head clearly mentioning bid nu mber duly signed and stamped. 2. Past Performance: The bidder should have experience of successfully executing supply and installa tion of Kids/children furniture in last three years ending on 31 March 2026 in an y state or central Govt school/college/institution. The bidder should provide tech nically clear completion certificate in appropriate format mentioning details of v

alue of tender, value of work awarded, time of completion and result of perform ance etc. 3. Safety and Quality standards: The manufacturer must posses' certificate of ISO Certificates from NABCB:ISO 9 001-2015 (Quality Management), ISO 14001-2015 (Environmental Management ), ISO 45001-2018 (Occupational Health & Safety), ISO-21016 or IS 17633:2022 (stability, strength and durability) andISO-50001 (Energy Management – Option al), ISO 22301-2019,IGBC,SEFA,ZED GOLD, GREEN PRO& AIOTA certificate. 4. Test Report: The bidder shall submit product test reports issued by laboratories accredited b y NABL or by any BIS-recognized/empanelled laboratory under the BIS Laborato ry Recognition Scheme (LRS), with testing conducted strictly as per the latest a pplicable Indian Standards. The test report must clearly indicate the product na me, model, applicable standard, date of testing, validity, and conformity of all mandatory parametersas per (IS 17633:2022). Reports from non-accredited or non-recognized laboratories shall not be accepted. The Procuring Authority rese rves the right to verify the authenticity of submitted reports and to reject any re port found incomplete, invalid, or inconsistent with the bid requirements. 5. Boucher/Catalogue: All bidders shall upload the catalogue/brochure of each quoted item along with t heir bid, clearly indicating the make, model and detailed technical specifications of the item offered. The submitted catalogue/brochure must corre spond to the exact make and model quoted in the bid and shall serve as the bas is for technical evaluation. Any bid not accompanied by the requisite catalogue/ brochure or containing incomplete or ambiguous details may be rejected as tec hnically non-responsive. After qualification in the technical evaluation, no change, substitution or d eviation in the declared make, model or specifications of the quoted items shall be permitted. The successful bidder shall supply items strictly in accordance wit h the make, model and specifications declared in the submitted catalogue/broc hure and accepted during technical evaluation. Any deviation shall be treated a s a breach of the bid conditions and may attract appropriate action as per the te rms and conditions of the bid. 6. Financial Eligibility: The Annual Turnover of the bidder (Reseller / Non-OEM) during the last three fin ancial years shall be not less than ₹5,50,000 (Rupees Five Lakh & Fifty thousan d only), supported by audited financial statements or CA-certified statements of accounts for the relevant years. In case the bidder is not the OEM, the OEM of th e offered product shall have a Minimum Annual Turnover of ₹44,00,000 (Rupees Fourty Four Lakh only) during the last three financial years, supported by audited financial statements or CA-certified statements. Supporting docume nts must be uploaded under the “Turnover Documents” section of the GeM bid. Bidder shall submit CA-Certified financial statement, including supporting sched ules, conforming turnover and profitability, Income Tax Returns (ITR) for the last

three fiscal years and GSTR-3B filing for last three months must accompany the Bid. 7. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) and EMD exemption: An EMD amounting to INR 44,000 (Fourty Four Thousand) must be pledged in fa vour of the Chief Education Officer, Ganderbal, and submitted along with the bid proposal. Failure to comply will lead to disqualification of the bidder. The bidder seeking EMD exemption must submit the valid supporting document for the relevant category as per GeM terms and condition with the bid. Under M SE category only manufacturers of goodsand service providers for services are eligible for exemption from EMD. 8. OEM Product Data Sheet Requirement: The bidder shall submit the official Product Data Sheet (PDS) issued by the Origi nal Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) for each product offered in the bid. The Pro duct Data Sheet must include, at a minimum, the product name, model number , technical specifications, key features, compliance certifications, operating con ditions, and warranty information.The Product Data Sheet shall serve as evidenc e that the product being offered is genuine, OEM-approved, and meets the tech nical requirements specified in the bid. Bidders failing to provide the OEM Produ ct Data Sheet may be considered non-compliant, and their bid may be rejected. All Product Data Sheets must be uploaded in the “Technical Documents” sectio n of the GeM bid along with the quotation. Buyers shall verify the Data Sheet wit h the offered specifications. Any mismatch will render the bid liable for rejection . 9. Declaration and Undertakings: The Bidder and OEM must submit an Undertaking and Affidavit on non-judicial s tamp paper of ₹500, affirming that neither has been debarred, blacklisted and s uspended by any Central/State Government Department, University, or PSU. 10. Delivery Condition: The Supply of items should be made within the time period of 10 days from the date of issuance of contract.All the items shall be delivered and installed at the designated sites on FOR destination basis. In case of delayed in supply or install ation, liquidated damage up to 1% per week, subject to maximum of 10% of ord er value will be imposed. 11. Service Support: The OEM/Bidder must give the certificate to provideimmediate services and tec hnical support on site for the period of 3 years minimum. Bidder are requested t o provide escalation matrix for effective service support. 12. Payment terms: Payment shall be made after successful delivery and installation,a certificationt o this effect must be furnished from the concerned HOIs.The Committee shall u ndertake the verification of procured materials and inspect each delivered item

to confirm its conformity with the agreed-upon specifications, quality, quantity, and any other pertinent parameters outlined in the Bid terms and conditions be fore the payment. 13. The bidders should also abide by the rules laid down in the GFR-2017 and Proc urement of Goods and Services strictly. 14. The quantity of the items in the bid is subject to availability of funds which can decrease or increase. 15. That bidder should strictly adhere to the rule viz a viz communication with the Department i.e. that they shall not make any telephonic Messages/calls and Per sonal approach to any govt. official of this office. However, in case of any query bidder must approach via GeM platform only. 16. At any stage during the bidding process or after the issuance of the formal sup ply order, if any document submitted by the participating firm is found to be for ged, invalid, tampered with, misleading, or otherwise non-genuine, this office re serves the absolute right to cancel/terminate the bid, reject the offer, or annul t he supply order without any liability whatsoever. The participating bidder shall mandatorily submit a bid-specific undertaking affirming the authenticity, gen uineness, and validity of all documents submitted and confirming unconditional compliance with this condition 17. Compliance Certificate: All the bidders must submit bid compliance certificate regarding bid document and bid ATCs and technical compliance for each item on bidder’s letter head . 2.
